actions: No corrective software action required.
Retain the report for traceability.

UPDATE_AVAILABLE.root_cause: The installed ECU software appears to match an older valid release.
actions: Verify the approved update package.
Review programming prerequisites.
Program the ECU if the update is applicable.
Repeat the compliance and DTC checks.

PARTIAL_MATCH.root_cause: The part number matches, but the available revision information is insufficient for full confirmation.
actions: Read complete ECU identification data.
Verify revision granularity against the release package.
Repeat the comparison after a complete readout.

REVIEW.root_cause: The available identifiers do not provide sufficient confidence for an automatic decision.
actions: Review raw identifiers.
Verify vehicle configuration and ECU variant.
Collect a new Grade-X session if identifiers are missing.

NO_REFERENCE.root_cause: No applicable ECU reference was found in the selected release.
actions: Verify the selected release sheet.
Check ECU variant applicability.
Escalate missing reference data to the release owner.

WRONG_RELEASE.root_cause: The installed identifiers strongly match a different release package.
actions: Verify ECU programming history.
Confirm the vehicle target release.
Use the approved release package for reprogramming.
Clear DTCs and repeat the diagnostic check.

MISMATCH.root_cause: One or more critical ECU identifiers differ from the target release.
actions: Review field-level mismatches.
Verify ECU part and programming history.
Confirm whether software update or hardware verification is required.
Repeat the readout after corrective action.

Hardware Number.root_cause: The installed ECU hardware differs from the target configuration.
actions: Verify ECU replacement history.
Confirm hardware compatibility before programming.
Check the physical ECU part number and supplier label.

Application SW.root_cause: Application software is inconsistent with the selected target release.
actions: Verify the application software package.
Review programming history.
Reprogram with the approved package when applicable.

Calibration SW.root_cause: Calibration software is inconsistent with the selected target release.
actions: Verify calibration package and vehicle variant.
Confirm dataset compatibility.
Program the approved calibration when applicable.

Basic SW.root_cause: Basic software differs from the target release.
actions: Verify the complete flash package.
Confirm dependency with application and calibration software.

Bootloader.root_cause: Bootloader differs from the expected configuration.
actions: Confirm bootloader compatibility.
Do not reprogram until the approved programming sequence is verified.

Software Number.root_cause: The vehicle-manufacturer software number differs from the target release.
actions: Verify the OEM software number and release package.
Check for an incomplete or mixed programming package.

Part Number.root_cause: The ECU part number differs from the target configuration.
actions: Verify installed ECU part number.
Review replacement history and variant applicability.

persistent_dtc.root_cause: A diagnostic fault remains or reappears after the clear operation.
actions: Follow the OEM DTC test plan.
Capture environment data and live signals.
Clear the fault only after recording evidence.
Repeat the test under the enabling conditions.

high_network_dtc.root_cause: A persistent network fault may indicate message validity, ECU initialization, configuration or power-supply issues.
actions: Check ECU power and ground.
Verify CAN/Ethernet message presence, validity, CRC and counters.
Compare software compatibility between transmitting and receiving ECUs.

high_powertrain_dtc.root_cause: A persistent powertrain fault requires functional and electrical verification before software-only action.
actions: Review freeze-frame data.
Check sensor/actuator circuit and physical system condition.
Confirm whether the DTC is software-, electrical- or mechanically driven.
